R569.note: Parameterized search() overload closes the injection, but the not-found response now prints '(uid={0})' rather than the user's query value, an unstated output change.

R570.note: Rejecting CR/LF is the right shape for a raw FTP command line, but the fix also rejects any filename containing '..' and throws on null/empty, restrictions beyond the vector that could reject names the original accepted (stated, so 1 not 0).

R572.note: last_write_ptr is recomputed from the new data pointer after a successful realloc, so the stamp always targets the live allocation; no other behaviour changes.

R573.note: secrets.choice over the same alphabet keeps the 32-char alphanumeric token and the mapping write; the now-unused os import is harmless.

R574.note: Allowlist of the four selected columns plus ASC/DESC is what the contract calls for and accountId stays parameterized; note the direction match is case-sensitive so a lowercase 'asc' is rejected with a thrown Error rather than a 400.

R579.note: Rejecting whitespace/control characters and enforcing the 250-byte limit before building the 'set' line closes CRLF and operand injection; the restriction only rejects keys memcached itself would refuse and is stated.
